content.json: Only `/api` requests are traced (pages and files aren't); health checks and the probes add no request rows. Every row here is from `kingofwees-logs`. Why → `docs/patterns/telemetry.md` in the repository.

content.query: AppRequests | summarize requests = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), ResultCode | render columnchart
content.title: Requests by response code

content.query: AppRequests | summarize p95 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)), requests = count() by Name | order by p95 desc
content.title: Slowest routes (p95 ms) and their requests
Memory (working set), CPU and restarts — the container app's own metrics

content.query: AppAvailabilityResults | summarize up = countif(Success), down = countif(not(Success)), slowest_ms = max(DurationMs) by Location | order by Location asc
content.title: Reachable from outside (the availability test, by location)

content.query: AppAvailabilityResults | summarize ok = countif(Success), failed = countif(not(Success)) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}) | render columnchart
content.title: Probes over time

content.query: Usage | where IsBillable | summarize MB = round(sum(Quantity), 2) by DataType | order by MB desc
content.title: Telemetry ingested (MB, billable) by table — the cap is 50 MB a day

content.query: AppRequests | where toint(ResultCode) >= 400 | project TimeGenerated, Name, ResultCode, DurationMs, OperationId | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 200
content.title: Failed requests (4xx and 5xx) — the operation id joins the dependencies and traces behind one

content.query: AppDependencies | where Success == false | summarize failures = count(), last = max(TimeGenerated) by Target, Name, ResultCode | order by failures desc
content.title: Dependencies that failed

content.query: AppTraces | where tostring(Properties['CategoryName']) == 'KingOfWees.Server.Diagnostics.ClientDiagnostic' | project TimeGenerated, Message | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 100
content.title: What visitors' browsers reported

content.query: AppRequests | where ResultCode in ('429', '403') | summarize refused = count(), last = max(TimeGenerated) by Name, ResultCode | order by refused desc
content.title: Requests the server refused — 429 rate-limited, 403 posting from outside the US

content.query: AppTraces | where tostring(Properties['CategoryName']) == 'KingOfWees.Server.Validation.ValidationFilter' | extend Route = tostring(Properties['Route']), Codes = tostring(Properties['Codes']) | summarize refusals = count(), last = max(TimeGenerated) by Route, Codes | order by refusals desc
content.title: Validation refusals by route and code (what phones send that the server won't take)

content.query: union (AppRequests | where toint(ResultCode) >= 500 | project TimeGenerated, What = strcat('request ', Name, ' → ', ResultCode), OperationId), (AppExceptions | project TimeGenerated, What = strcat('exception ', ExceptionType, ': ', OuterMessage), OperationId) | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 100
content.title: Server errors (5xx) and exceptions

content.query: AppRequests | where Name == 'GET /api/king/status' | summarize visits = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d) | render columnchart
content.title: Home loads a day (one status read per load)

content.query: AppRequests | where Name in ('GET /api/king/status', 'GET /api/king/history', 'GET /api/king/photos', 'GET /api/king/heat') | extend Page = case(Name has 'history', 'History', Name has 'photos', 'Photos', Name has 'heat', 'Heat map', 'Home') | summarize opened = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), Page | render columnchart
content.title: Pages opened a day

content.query: AppRequests | where Name == 'GET /api/king/status' | summarize visits = count() by hour = hourofday(TimeGenerated) | order by hour asc | render columnchart
content.title: When in the day people check on King (hour, UTC)

content.query: AppMetrics | where Name in ('king.feedings', 'king.sightings', 'king.photos') | summarize posted = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), Name | render columnchart
content.title: Feedings, sightings and photos a day

content.query: AppRequests | where Name == 'GET /api/king/photos/{id}/thumb' and ResultCode == '200' | summarize served = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d) | render columnchart
content.title: Photos looked at a day (thumbnails served)

content.query: AppMetrics | where Name startswith 'king.admin.' | summarize actions = sum(Sum) by Name, Target = tostring(Properties['target']) | order by actions desc
content.title: Admin actions (hides, restores, renames, merges)

content.query: AppMetrics | where Name == 'king.posting.refused' | summarize refused = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d) | render columnchart
content.title: Posts refused from outside the US, a day
